name: Couture beading
summary: Beads and sequins are sewn by hand on a cloth, one by one or in a chain, in rows that make a dense, glittering surface.
how: Stretch the satin on a frame and draw the pattern on it.
Sew the beads with a hooked needle, or a thread of 3 to 5 beads at a time.
Check the rows against the drawing, so that the lines run even to the millimetre.

origin.note: Embroidery houses of Paris, such as the Lesage atelier of 1924, make beading a craft of couture; bead embroidery itself is much older.

adoptions.via: The Baguette bag is covered in hand-sewn beads and sequins, and each colourway takes days of work.
